about.p2: Strategically located near Belawan Port — Indonesia's key maritime gateway for Sumatra — we bridge local businesses with global markets efficiently, legally, and professionally.

items.q: What is undername import and how does it work?
items.a: Undername import is a legal arrangement where DBM uses our API-U license to import goods on behalf of your business. Your goods, your cost — we provide the customs identity. Fees are typically 1.5%–3% of CIF value plus duty and VAT as pass-through costs.

items.q: What commodities can DBM help import or export?
items.a: Our KBLI codes cover fertilizers, food ingredients, coffee/tea/cocoa, oil-bearing fruits, fresh vegetables, flowers, household appliances, motorcycle spare parts, and general merchandise. Contact us for commodities not listed — we assess each case individually.

items.q: How does the PIB customs process work?
items.a: PIB (Pemberitahuan Impor Barang) is the import declaration filed through CEISA/INSW. We handle all steps: document prep, HS code classification, PIB submission, duty payment, and port clearance. Most shipments clear in 1–3 business days on green/yellow lane.

items.q: Can DBM handle exports from North Sumatra?
items.a: Yes. We manage the full export process: PEB filing, Certificate of Origin (COO), phytosanitary certificates, shipping coordination, and documentation. We specialize in Sumatran commodities like coffee, CPO, rubber, and agricultural products via Belawan Port.

items.q: What is EUDR and does it affect my exports?
items.a: EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) requires proof that commodities entering the EU were not produced on deforested land after Dec 31, 2020. If you export palm oil, coffee, cocoa, rubber, soy, or wood products to the EU, you need a Due Diligence Statement (DDS). We help you prepare this.

items.q: How do I start working with DBM?
items.a: Contact us via WhatsApp (+62 812-6488-2678) or email. We respond within 24 hours. Our team will assess your requirements, provide a transparent fee proposal, and guide you through the process from first shipment onward.
